2609.39967.title: What Limits Recursive Reasoning Models: Optimization, Architecture and Test-Time Scaling
2609.39967.paper_summary: Recursive reasoning models apply a small shared Transformer block many times to refine a latent state. This gives them large effective depth with few parameters and makes them strong on algorithmic tasks. Such compact solvers are natural candidates for tools that an LLM can call on narrow algorithmic subproblems. However, existing models such as HRM, TRM and URM differ in architecture, gradient propagation and training procedure simultaneously. This makes it hard to tell what drives their performance, and their optimization is still poorly understood and often unstable. In this work we address both of these gaps. First, we study these questions under a unified experimental pipeline spanning six algorithmic domains. Individual controlled ablations are performed on representative domains, while the resulting recipe is evaluated across the full suite. The study reveals a surprisingly simple recipe for stable and generalizable recursive reasoning: an intermediate gradient horizon, large physical batches and controlled updates of the recurrent state. An explicit hierarchical architecture is not needed. Second, we combine these findings into a stable 13.6M-parameter model that achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated recursive baselines, with particularly large gains on out-of-distribution generalization. It raises Arithmetic OOD accuracy to 71.2%, from 36.2% for the strongest baseline, while reaching 98.41% on Sudoku and 59.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1. Our results show that, within the recursive architectures studied here, performance depends strongly on how recurrence is optimized and stabilized. More broadly, it shows how AI systems can be improved by optimizing their components one at a time.
2609.39967.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸推理模型多次應用小型共享的 Transformer 區塊來細化潛在狀態。<lb/>這使它們在參數較少的情況下擁有較大的有效深度，並在算法任務上表現出色。<lb/>這種緊湊的解決方案自然成為 LLM 可以用來解決狹窄算法子問題的工具的候選者。<lb/>然而，現有模型如 HRM、TRM 和 URM 在架構、梯度傳播和訓練過程上同時存在差異。<lb/>這使得很難判斷它們性能的驅動因素，而它們的優化仍然不太明瞭且經常不穩定。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們解決了這兩個問題。<lb/>首先，我們在涵蓋六個算法領域的統一實驗流程下研究這些問題。<lb/>在代表性領域上進行個別的控制性消融實驗，同時對整個套件進行評估。<lb/>研究揭示了一個驚人簡單的穩定且可泛化的遞歸推理配方：中間梯度視野、大批量物理數據和對遞歸狀態的控制性更新。<lb/>不需要明確的層次架構。<lb/>其次，我們將這些發現結合成一個穩定的 1360 萬參數模型，該模型在評估的遞歸基準中達到了最強的整體性能，特別是在分佈外泛化上獲得了顯著增益。<lb/>它將算術 OOD 準確率提高到 71.2%，而最強基準的準確率為 36.2%，同時在數獨上達到 98.41% 和在 ARC-AGI-1 上達到 59.5% pass@2。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，在這裡研究的遞歸架構中，性能強烈依賴於遞歸的優化和穩定化方式。<lb/>更廣泛地說，這顯示了如何通過逐一優化其組件來改善 AI 系統。
